dialogs.about: 아들이 새로 얻을 집 계약을 할머니와 의논해요

lines.en: Mom, I found a small house last week.
Really? How is the neighborhood there?
It is quiet. The neighbors are very kind.
That's nice. Is the rent high?
No. The rent is not high for us.
Did you read the contract well?
Yes. I read it with the agent yesterday.
Good. What is the condition of the house?
It is clean. The utility bills are small too.
Thank you. I will visit your new house soon.

dialogs.about: 중개인 사무실에서 딸의 임대차 계약을 함께 살펴요

lines.en: Hello. We came about the lease today.
lines.ko: 안녕하세요. 오늘 임대차 계약 때문에 왔어요.

lines.en: Welcome. Please sit here, Ma'am.
Thank you. Who is the tenant on this paper?
Your daughter is the tenant.
Is the deed of the house safe?
Yes. I checked the deed this morning.
lines.ko: 네. 오늘 아침에 등기 문서를 확인했어요.

lines.en: Good. Does the rent change every year?
No. The rent stays the same for two years.
lines.ko: 아니요. 집세가 이 년 동안 그대로예요.

lines.en: That's a good guarantee for my daughter.
Yes. I will bring the contract papers on Friday.
lines.ko: 네. 금요일에 계약 서류를 가져다 드릴게요.
